{{Broader|List of mathematicians|List of Norwegians}}

A [[mathematician]] is a scholar in the fields of [[mathematics]]. They solve and research [[mathematical problem]]s which can be applied in real life or completely abstract (pure). This article covers notable '''mathematicians from [[Norway]]'''.

A pioneer of modern mathematics,<ref>{{cite encyclopedia |title=Niels Henrik Abel |url=https://www.britannica.com/biography/Niels-Henrik-Abel |encyclopedia=[[Britannica]] |access-date=6 September 2022}}</ref> [[Niels Henrik Abel]] contributed greatly towards various fields of mathematics<ref name="abel-bio">{{cite web |title=A mathematical genious |url=https://abelprize.no/page/about-niels-henrik-abel |website=[[Abel Prize]] |access-date=6 September 2022}}</ref> during his short life. He died in 1829, aged 26, from [[tuberculosis]].<ref name="abel-bio" /> German mathematician [[Felix Klein]] spoke of his reluctance "to part from this ideal type of researcher".<ref>Klein, Felix. ''[[Development of mathematics in the 19th century]]''. Math Sci Press, 1979, p.&nbsp;97.</ref> In 2001, the [[Abel Prize]] was established in his honour.<ref>{{cite web|last=Devlin|first=Keith|author-link=Keith Devlin|url=http://www.maa.org/devlin/devlin_04_04.html|title=Abel Prize Awarded: The Mathematicians' Nobel|date=April 2004 |publisher=[[Mathematical Association of America]] |access-date=4 November 2012|url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120827093315/http://www.maa.org/devlin/devlin_04_04.html |archive-date=27 August 2012}}</ref>

Other notable mathematicians include (in alphabetical order) [[Carl Anton Bjerknes]], [[Vilhelm Bjerknes]], [[Bernt Michael Holmboe]], who is known for being Abel's teacher and tutor,<ref>{{cite news|first=Arild |last=Stubhaug |author-link=Arild Stubhaug |title=Den inspirerende læreren |work=[[Forskning.no]] |date=25 May 2004 |access-date=20 February 2009 |url=http://www.forskning.no/Artikler/2004/mai/1084540184.71/artikkel_print |language=Norwegian |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070929115955/http://www.forskning.no/Artikler/2004/mai/1084540184.71/artikkel_print |archive-date=29 September 2007 }}</ref> [[Sophus Lie]], [[Idun Reiten]], [[Atle Selberg]], [[Thoralf Skolem]] and [[Carl Størmer]].
